articleTitle: Code-mixed Text: An Extensive Literature Review
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Code-mixed text refers to communication or writing that combines elements from two or more languages or linguistic varieties within the same conversation, sentence, or even phrase. This study of the literature explores the dynamic and expanding field of code-mixed text, a linguistic phenomenon that is defined as a hassle-free integration of two or more languages in a single communication. As communication channels diversify and globalize, code-mixing has become increasingly prevalent across various mediums, including social media, instant messaging, and online platforms. This review synthesizes existing research spanning linguistic, sociolinguistic, and computational perspectives, providing a holistic overview of the key themes, methodologies, and findings in the field.

articleTitle: Navigating the Tourism Terrain: A Holistic Approach from Industry Dynamics to Marketing Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The tourism industry is vital to the world economy and plays a major role in it. The adoption and effects of Intelligent Travel Technology (ITT) for passengers and destinations are the main topics of this study, which explores the relationship between technology, tourism, and society. The project, which employs a mixed-method approach, aims to create a complete framework with a primary focus onintegrating technology with human values. Basic elements include the analysis of traveler demographics, market trends, and the tourism sectors. The study examines how tourism has changed in the digital era, with a focus on ICT and novelties likeaugmented and virtual reality. It also covers pertinent case studies, socio-technical issues, and efficient marketing techniques for tourism-related firms.

articleTitle: Heart Diseases Prediction Using machine learning and Deep learning Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Heart disorders cause a great deal of illness and mortality, making them a major worldwide health concern. In order to lessen the effects of cardiovascular illnesses, early detection and intervention are essential. In order to improve the precision and effectiveness of heart disease prediction, this study investigates the application of machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) approaches. Using a variety of datasets that include clinical measurements, medical histories, and patient demographics, predictive models are created to identify complex patterns that may indicate cardiovascular risk. In addition to sophisticated DL models like neural networks and convolutional neural networks (CNN), traditional machine learning algorithms like logistic regression, decision trees, and ensemble approaches are also used on the job. The study explores the technical nuances of model construction as well as ethical issues, privacy concerns with data, and the relationship between data scientists and medical experts. The aim is to construct precise and comprehensible models that enable doctors to provide proactive insights for individualized patient care, so contributing to the improvement of cardiovascular healthcare. It is expected that the study project’s results will have an influence on cardiovascular health, promoting early identification, well-informed choices, and eventually bettering patient outcomes in the field of heart disease treatment.

articleTitle: Media Blend – A Reading App
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving digital landscape, the demand for versatile and engaging reading experiences has grown exponentially. This abstract introduces a comprehensive reading app designed to cater to diverse user preferences by seamlessly integrating news updates, captivating stories with voice recognition capabilities, and curated video content.The app offers a dynamic news section, providing users with real-time and personalized news updates from reliable sources. Users can customize their news feed based on their interests, ensuring a tailored and relevant information consumption experience.One of the standout features of the app is its interactive storytelling functionality, enhanced by cutting-edge voice recognition technology. Users can immerse themselves in a hands-free reading experience, allowing the app to narrate stories with natural language processing. This feature not only accommodates visually impaired users but also offers a unique and immersive way for all users to enjoy content.Furthermore, the app incorporates a curated collection of videos covering a wide array of topics, including educational content, entertainment, and news analysis. This multimedia approach aims to engage users on multiple sensory levels, providing a holistic reading experience that goes beyond traditional text-based content.The user-friendly interface ensures easy navigation, while advanced algorithms continually refine content recommendations based on user preferences and interactions. Additionally, the app fosters community engagement by allowing users to share and discuss their favourite content with a built-in social sharing feature. The Multifaceted Reading App is a comprehensive solution that caters to the evolving needs of modern readers. By seamlessly blending news updates, voice-enhanced storytelling, and curated videos, the app offers a dynamic and personalized reading experience that transcends traditional boundaries, making it an indispensable tool for avid readers in the digital age.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches in Contemporary Automatic Bug Triaging and Analysis of Research Gaps
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The main aim of software development is to release the product with zero defects. Software development methodology starts from gathering the requirements till software testing maintenance. The testers perform a Software Testing process by comparing the actual and expected results. In the process of software testing whenever there is a mismatch between the expected and actual results, a bug is reported. Bug Triaging is a crucial process in software testing. Bug triaging refers to the process of getting the bug resolved at the right time by the right resource person The main idea of bug triaging is to get the bugs fixed within the timelines by the appropriate resource person. Bugs are addressed by the testing team using a bug report template. If a bug report is well-defined and easy to understand the developer finds it easier to understand and fix the bugs within the timelines. The bug report contains the bug’s characteristics including the description, ID, priority, steps to replicate the bug, hardware, and software configurations in which the bug was reported, and various other characteristics of the bug. Initially, the developers allocated the bugs using a manual distribution process. When there are hundreds or thousands of bugs reported in the software every month automatic bug triaging plays an efficient role in the timely resolution of the bugs. Bug triaging problems can be viewed as a machine learning application in which automatically the bugs are assigned to the appropriate developer. The main objective of Automatic Bug Triaging is to make a model that assigns bugs to appropriate developers with high accuracy to reduce the time of bug allocation to the developers. Various Machine Learning approaches have been used in the past years. In this paper, we will study various automatic bug-triaging approaches and discuss the findings and gaps of the discussed approaches. The main agenda of this research paper is to provide a detailed study related to Bug and Bug reports, analyze the various approaches to Automatic Bug Triaging and its practical implications, discuss the gaps in the existing approaches, and focus on the future scope and challenges related to automatic triaging. The customization, scalability, and adaptability of the machine learning techniques make it best suitable for Bug triaging purposes.

articleTitle: Privacy-Preserving Speech Analysis- A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Speech-recognition technology is an essential component of many smart IoT devices. To make these systems secure and privacy-preserving, it is important to consider outsourcing speech-recognition functionality to a third-party storage provider. By removing the speech-recognition process from the device itself, the amount of personal data stored on the device is minimized. Additionally, the provider can ensure the strictest security standards are met when the audio data is stored, including the use of encryption and access control mechanisms. Furthermore, the provider can also ensure that the speech-recognition process is done using the latest technologies to ensure accurate recognition of the audio data. To ensure the end-user’ s privacy is kept intact, the provider should allow only authorized users to access the audio data. Additionally, the provider should also enable data access logging and audit trails allowing for the tracking of any access to the data. By outsourcing speech-recognition services to a third-party, smart IoT devices can ensure the highest levels of privacy and security while still enabling users to get the most out of their device. The server processes the encrypted data to generate recognition results, such as user commands and voice printing, without compromising the privacy of the user’ s voice data. To enhance voice data privacy, federated learning can be employed in the design of these models. This approach enables distributed training of the model without the need to transmit the user’ s voice data to a central server. The adoption of this approach in the IoT industry is gaining momentum as it offers the potential to create smarter and more secure IoT devices that inspire customer trust.

articleTitle: NLP Unleashed: Transforming Employment Landscapes with Dynamic Recruitment Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The “Job Recruitment Platform” is an innovative system that revolutionizes the recruitment process by integrating Natural Language Processing (NLP) and advanced interview analysis. It offers dynamic profiles for job seekers, transforming traditional resumes into adaptable documents that highlight skills, provide career recommendations, and facilitate networking. For job providers, the platform streamlines hiring with emotion analysis in video interviews, ensuring authentic candidate responses. Machine learning algorithms generate a Job Fit Score, prioritizing the most suitable candidates and improving recruitment efficiency.

articleTitle: Plant Disease Detection Using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: In today’s world AI is becoming more popular, to improve the quality, and result of their product. So, we have also taken some groundbreaking step in the realm of plant disease detection, utilizing the cutting-edge power of (CNNs). The proposed project aims to address the pressing issue of plant diseases and their detrimental impact on farmers in India. By leveraging deep learning tools and natural language processing techniques, the system provides quick and accurate analysis of plant health based on leaf images, assisting farmers in combating diseases and preventing losses.

articleTitle: Emotional Intelligence: A Novel Method for Multi-Criteria Decision-Making with Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: In the modern era, the marketplace brims with various products and items, each distinguished by unique features and functions, leaving the users with multiple choices. This abundance poses an issue, as it becomes challenging for the customer to decide which product to purchase. For example, each year, new electronic devices, like laptops, smartphones, and televisions, are being manufactured by various brands with similar features and functions, making it difficult for customers to select the option that best aligns with their needs. A customer will usually only look at one criterion at a time, such as product rating, which may not result in the most accurate selection. In this paper, we explore sentiment analysis using Vader Lexicon on product reviews of Fine Foods from Amazon to calculate the compound sentiment of the various items. This sentiment score is then used as a criterion along with Product scores in the Weighted Sum MCDM approach to estimate the ranks, providing a more comprehensive and informed method for consumers to choose.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Arrhythmia Classification: Unleashing the Power of Machine Learning and Data Amplification for Precision Healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive exploration of arrhythmia classification using machine learning techniques applied to electrocardiogram (ECG) signals. The study delves into the development and evaluation of diverse models, including K-Nearest Neighbors, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree Classifier, Linear and Kernelized Support Vector Machines, and Random Forest. The models undergo rigorous analysis, emphasizing precision and recall due to the categorical nature of the dependent variable. To enhance model robustness and address class imbalances, Principal Component Analysis (PCA) and Random Oversampling are employed. The results highlight the effectiveness of the Kernelized SVM with PCA, achieving a remarkable accuracy of 99.52%. Additionally, the paper discusses the positive impact of feature reduction and oversampling on model performance. The study concludes with insights into the significance of PCA and Random Oversampling in refining arrhythmia classification models, offering potential avenues for future research in healthcare analytics.

articleTitle: A Study on Consumer Perception towards Online Shopping in India
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The internet has become a more efficient and basic tool for all needs and the way people work, by integrating various web management tools on the internet, innovative companies have created a payment system to accept customer orders, facilitate payments, customer service, collect marketing information and online. The benchmarking considers ecommerce challenges, their business model, financing, revenue generation, growth, survival strategies, online shopping experience of buyers, value addition and product offering differentiation. E-commerce retailers are investing to ensure that customers have a friendly interface across all digital devices, but this study reveals the perception of customers who have a consistent experience across digital devices. This study also sheds light on the relationship between demographic factors and customer perception of content.

articleTitle: Company Crime Tracking System with Blockchain Technology to enhance security, and accountability
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The difficulties that security departments in businesses or organisations face are actually so numerous that using blockchain as a solution is now necessary. It is an innovative attempt to leverage the revolutionary potential of blockchain technology to address the ongoing problems related to corporate crimes. Corporate crimes have serious negative effects on a company’s finances, reputation, and legal standing. These crimes include fraud, embezzlement, insider trading, and data breaches. The need to increase data security, expedite regulatory compliance, build stakeholder trust, prevent financial losses, adjust to changing legal frameworks, and contribute to the development of a more stable and morally sound international business environment is what drives this paper. This paper seeks to establish companies as leaders in responsible corporate governance and technical innovation by revolutionising corporate crime prevention and accountability. Its potential influence goes beyond specific businesses; it holds forth the prospect of a more reliable and morally upright international business climate. Together, these elements provide a strong foundation for monitoring, stopping, and prosecuting corporate crimes while maintaining data security, openness, and compliance with legal and regulatory requirements, as well as raising awareness among the company’s employees.It goes through development, data privacy and security implementation, testing, deployment, and user training. The focus of the paper is on continuous assessment, documentation, scalability, legal compliance, auditing, and monitoring. The purpose of this paper is to demonstrate how businesses can quickly identify and keep an eye on unauthorised activity so that the right decisions may be made.

articleTitle: Language Identification and Normalization Techniques for Code-Mixed Text
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: With billions of users worldwide, social media platforms have developed into crucial communication tools that enable the interchange of knowledge, ideas, and feelings. However, natural language processing (NLP) tasks in social media material are significantly hampered by its informal and unstructured nature. In order to fully utilize the value of social media data for a variety of applications, such as sentiment analysis, Language Translation, chat bots, and recommendation systems, text normalization is a crucial preprocessing step. This review paper offers a thorough analysis of text normalization methods designed expressly for the peculiarities of social media language.

articleTitle: Performance Assessment of Leach and the Suggested Improvements to the M-Leach Protocol for Use in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Nowadays, due to global warming, which is alarmingly increasing and causing natural calamities worldwide, due to counter impact, the world is talking much about green energy, natural resources, etc. In this paper, we discussed one of the popular networks, wireless sensor networks, which has gained popularity since it has been widely used in remote sensing applications. These networks can provide information about places where the government must concentrate to reduce the emission of gases which will affect the environment. Wireless sensor networks consist of sensor nodes, which are small gadgets powered by batteries and have limited energy resources. As a result of this limitation, these networks have a reduced lifespan. By employing various routing protocols, it is possible to extend the lifespans of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). LEACH, a protocol known for its low energy use, serves as an exemplar of such protocols. This study enhanced the M-LEACH (Multi-hop) protocol by integrating the real-time energy status of sensor nodes into the cluster head selection process. This approach enhances the overall lifespan of the network and addresses the problem of selecting low-energy nodes as cluster heads. articleTitle: Crime Detection Using Data Mining Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Crime is an act or event punishable by law. As crime rates continue to rise, we need technology to reduce and investigate crime. Data mining algorithms and techniques are being applied to massive data sets to find patterns and links in order to detect and prevent crime. This subject is one that is rapidly expanding. Many sorts of crime-related data, including criminal histories, police reports, surveillance footage, and social media data, can be analysed using data mining techniques. Image processing is the art of processing data and facts before they are analysed. Data mining techniques can help investigate, predict, and prevent crime. The data mining techniques used in this article are decision trees, a priori algorithms, k-means clustering, and linear regression. These methods are used to uncover crime patterns.

articleTitle: Impact of Financial Technology (Fin-Tech) on the Restructuring of the Agrarian Economy: A Comprehensive Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Agriculture, employing half of India’s workforce and contributing 17-18% to its GDP, stands as the largest employer in the country. Despite its significant role, the agricultural sector is remarkably disorganized. This lack of attention is evident in the decline of its GDP contribution from $43 \%$ to $18 \%$ between 1970 and 2018. While the Indian Government actively promotes digital financial inclusion for over 145 million households without banking access, farmers predominantly rely on traditional credit for key aspects such as production and distribution. Recognizing the pivotal role of the financial sector in elevating agriculture’s contribution to economic growth and poverty reduction, our paper explores the studies conducted in evolving technological landscape. This evolution presents opportunities to focus on and provide credit, share risks, and leverage technology for enhanced agricultural productivity. The paper initiates with an examination various previous article on agricultural finance and also the role of financial technology (Fin-Tech) policy makers to attain the innovative products in agrarian economy. This study is a systematic review to identify the impact of various fin-tech products & services such as; mobile banking, digital financial services, digital crop insurance, solar energy and blockchain technology, on agricultural finance. In conclusion, the paper discusses key policy considerations for Fin-Tech in agriculture, which affects the agricultural growth, enhance financial inclusion, and promote the cultivation by establishing agriculture as a desirable profession.

articleTitle: Real-time gender and people tracking using YOLO
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The objective of this research was to use the YOLO API and other vision-based tools to detect gender and keep track of the number of people in real-time. The CNN Darknet-53 was used for the gender classification. Two models namely YOLOv3 and YOLOv3-TINY were tested for gender detection to show the trade-off between speed and accuracy. An additional YOLOv3 model was also tested for people detection and tracking. The Google Colaboratory was used to train the network using a high-end GPU Nvidia Tesla K80 12GB on images from the ‘OpenImagesv5’ dataset. The YOLOv3 and YOLOv3-TINY models achieved commendable accuracy on the training set and people detection. The models were deployed using the OpenCV DNN module as well as the Flask web application development framework. The web application allows end-users to view the results in real-time on a web browser. Ultimately, the system was tested on the campus of the University of Mauritius and achieved an average detection accuracy of $94 \%$

articleTitle: Machine Learning in medical sites and healthcare
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Machine Learning is a technique through which computer learns by using the data provided from the user and getting experience from it and then using that experience to predict new things on its own. Machine learning has revolutionized the field of healthcare in recent years, and one area where it has found extensive application is in medical websites. Medical websites are essential resources for healthcare providers and patients, providing up-to-date information on medical conditions, treatments, and healthcare services. By incorporating machine learning algorithms into medical websites, healthcare providers can improve patient outcomes by enhancing the accuracy of diagnosis, optimizing treatment, and reducing the risk of medical errors. Machine Learning uses features like image processing, text recognition to scan reports and give summary of the report to the people. It also helps in predicting stages of diseases by scanning reports like X-Ray scans etc. and analyzing it. In this paper, we will explore the various ways in which machine learning is being used in medical websites, the benefits of this technology, and the challenges associated with its implementation.

articleTitle: Information Quality Dimensions in Generative Conversational AI for Financial Inclusion
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: This study aims to investigate the complex interactions between financial decision-making and the critical elements affecting the quality of information generated by Generative Conversational AI agents. Through an empirical investigation of these dynamics, the study seeks to illuminate the concrete consequences of utilising such agents to improve decision-making in financial inclusion. Using an information quality framework-based model and Purposive sampling, we collected data via online questionnaires from 328 banking and financial services customers. The SmartPLS analysis for SEM (structural equation modelling) produced enlightening findings. The research concludes that the representative, contextual, intrinsic, and accessible aspects of information quality significantly impact financial decision-making. This emphasises how important a role these dimensions play in determining how effective financial decisions are. Our results also highlight the critical influence that financial inclusion has on the general effectiveness of financial decision-making. The study aims to empirically investigate the valuable applications of Generative Conversational agents in management practices. This study establishes a foundation for future efforts to utilise AI-powered conversational agents in the ever-changing financial services industry by revealing the complex relationships between information quality and financial decision results.

articleTitle: YOLOv7-Based Helmet Detection System For Traffic Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The current predominant issue in India is the escalating number of traffic accidents, primarily attributed to the burgeoning population. A significant contributing factor to this problem is the widespread disregard for helmet usage, leading to an increase in accidents. This project aims to address this issue by implementing a system capable of recognizing individuals who are not wearing helmets and subsequently advising them to prioritize helmet use in the future. The fundamental principle guiding this system is deep learning, with the project encompassing two key phases: the initial detection of individuals and the subsequent identification of helmets using YOLOv7. The utilization of the YOLOv7 algorithm, launched in 2022, is specifically chosen for its accuracy and favorable results. In addressing the associated challenges, this project introduces a Non-Helmet Rider Detection system. This system strives to automate the identification of traffic violations related to non-helmet usage and extract license plate numbers from vehicles. Object detection through deep learning is implemented at three levels within this system. The primary objective is to mitigate the occurrence of head injuries by ensuring that individuals in potentially perilous environments adhere to the requisite protective headgear.

articleTitle: Duplicate Node Detection Method for Wireless Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are altering the world through their sensing technology. With several applications in ITS, military operations, surveillance systems, and other fields, WSNs have grown to be a powerful technology. A range of sensor nodes that gather environmental data and monitor the external environment make up wireless sensor networks (WSNs). Reducing the energy consumption of sensor networks to make the operation time longer is the main goal of many researches. The main issue with energy conservation has been the depletion of the batteries powering the sensor nodes. Furthermore, because of their security features, WSNs are utilized in vital areas, such as military battlefields. This study introduces the WSN in several situations, including data collection, applications, routing, security issues, and a quick rundown of a modeling platform that may be used to WSNs. This essay contributes by outlining WSNs’ significance and introducing them in a variety of operational contexts.

articleTitle: Two-Player Wizard Laser Tag-Inspired Shooting Game
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Sedentary Lifestyle and Obesity have become increasingly prevalent in India, leading to a variety of health issues. This project reviews existing solutions to this problem and proposes a new solution that leverages technology to encourage physical activity in a fun and engaging way. The proposed solution involves the use of infrared-based aiming and WiFi communication to create a wizard-themed game that promotes physical activity. The design constraints, features, and implementation plan are discussed in detail, and a solution is implemented by the end.

articleTitle: Enhancing E-Learning: A Comprehensive Guide to Performance Metrics and Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: In this paper we will talk about the analysis of Performance of Learner on E learning Platform using different matrices such as User Activity, Course Progress, Assessment Results, Engagement Metrices and Retention Metrics. Since it is very important to evaluate the performance of a student on E Learning Platform so that better Learning Platforms can be developed in terms of better learning interface, Course Content and Evaluation System. Understanding and analyzing learner performance are paramount in the development of superior e-learning platforms. By scrutinizing user engagement, tracking course progression, assessing results, and evaluating the overall learning experience, we aim to uncover patterns and areas for improvement. Our research underscores the importance of refining the learning interface, optimizing course content, and enhancing the evaluation system to create more effective e-learning environments. We believe that this analysis will contribute significantly to the evolution of e-learning platforms and ultimately lead to better educational outcomes. This study sheds light on the crucial role of data-driven analysis in shaping the future of online education. It underscores the significance of creating learning interfaces that resonate with users, refining course content to meet diverse needs, and establishing evaluation systems that foster continuous improvement. By doing so, we pave the way for more impactful and adaptive e-learning environments, ultimately benefiting both educators and learners alike.

articleTitle: Investigating Brain Tumor Detection and Classification through various Deep Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Classification and Detection of brain tumors is a significant phase to better understanding its appliance. MRI and CT scan images are used for experiment analysis and medical imaging method which helps the radiologists explore the tumor area. Moreover, it is time time-consuming procedure and needs expertise to analyze the MRI and CT images, manually. Recent advances, the new advancements in CAD, ML, and DL in particular enabled radiologists to more dependably identify brain tumors. The new approaches utilized to handle this need a hand-crafted feature for classification reasons. Whereas DL approaches can be developed to perform classification without any requirement for handcrafted features. This article compares the analysis of three different DL methods to classify brain tumors. Various brain tumor dataset categories, segmentation methods, and detection strategies are also presented. The 23-layered CNN model overtakes the AlexNet, and GoogleNet, models in terms of detection accuracy rate performance by 97.8%.

articleTitle: Building a Revolutionizing Application Platform Towards Knowledge Reality
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The rapid development of digital technology has significantly changed the educational landscape, especially in the field of distance learning, where time and space barriers separate students and teachers. This way of learning has found application at all levels of education and is most widely adopted by colleges. Modern courses often include traditional classroom instruction and distance learning components. In this article, we discuss the evolution of digital technology and its profound impact on open and distance learning. The versatility of digital technology is used in various ways according to the special needs of the target group and its technological availability. The adaptability of digital technology is utilized for a wide range of objectives, customized to suit the particular requirements and technological capabilities of the intended recipients. Significantly, these developments have introduced a heightened level of interactivity in the learning process, closely resembling the conventional in-person classroom setting; in effect, they have established an online classroom environment. In addition, by seamlessly integrating synchronous and asynchronous teaching methods, they have increased the adaptability and convenience of distance education to accommodate the varied requirements of students. This paper explores the profound impact of digital technology’s evolution on distance and open education and how these advances have resulted in a more interactive learning experience that closely mirrors the traditional face-to-face classroom environment, effectively creating a virtual classroom. It also improves the convenience and adaptability of distance learning by meeting the diverse needs of students by seamlessly combining both synchronous and asynchronous learning methods.

articleTitle: A Scrutinized Survey on the Accuracy & Availability of Sanskrit Translation Models
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Deep learning is the subset of Machine learning (ML), the new advanced AI technology of that involves training the artificial neural networks with many layers (hence ‘deep’) to learn from input data. Language translation is one of the vast fields of NLP which involves translating text from one language to other language, conserving the meaning of the input text, and producing fluent text in the output language. The initiative behind machine translation is to build up computer algorithms and to execute computer programs that will allow a computer to automatically translate human language from one language to another language without any human involvement during the translation process. This results to the formation of ‘Translation Models’ which are designed to explain the mathematical relationship between two or more languages. They are called models of translational equivalence because the main thing that they aim to predict is whether expressions in different languages have equivalent meanings or not. This manuscript focuses on the one of the most ancient and sacred language, Sanskrit found in almost all the holy books of Indian religion like Hinduism, Buddhism and Jainism. Jain narrative literature is found in Sanskrit, Prakrat and Apabhramsa which is rightly recognized as one of the South Asia’s great cultural heritages and a vital source of material for insight into pre modern Jain teachings, practices and everyday life. New AI model claims to translate 200 languages, making the technology accessible to more people. Is sanskrit a part of 200 languages? Can we rely on this new AI for accurate translations?This manuscript lays out the following surveys-•Existence of Translation models for Jain Literature present in Prakrit and Apbhramsa•Sanskrit translation models like Google translator, Glosbe translate etc. and their comparison (if any)•Accuracy of word and phrase translation from Sanskrit to hindi/english•Speech to Text or Text to Speech models to read Sanskrit literature•Algorithmic structure of Stemming and Lemmatization of Sanskrit words in NLP

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Drone Detection Model Using YOLO Versions
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: This article discusses a structured way for categorizing drones that combines deep learning with a number of other methodologies. It is impressive that this method was able to identify both fixed and moving objects with great accuracy. The You Only Look Once (YOLO) object detector is a well-liked and efficient method for object recognition. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have been developed for the analysis of visual data, automatically learning hierarchical representations of features from raw pixel inputs. The model is trained using the required dataset for 120 iterations in order to identify drones. In general, deep learning methods have transformed the field of computer vision, enabling impressive improvements in a range of tasks like picture classification, object recognition (including drone detection), segmentation, and image synthesis. To determine the optimum model for drone identification, different YOLOv7 models (YOLOv7, YOLOv7-X, YOLOv7-W6, YOLO-E6, YOLOv7-D6, and YOLO-E6E.) are compared.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study on Reputation Management in Social Cloud: Validating Our Proposed Trust Architecture with Multiple Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative study on reputation management in social cloud, focusing on validating a novel trust-based architecture through experimentation with multiple real-world datasets. The proposed architecture incorporates various components such as feedback collection, trust computation, and reputation propagation, aiming to improve reliability and robustness in managing user reputations within social clouds. We compare our approach with existing state-of-the-art methods and evaluate its effectiveness by analyzing results from four large-scale public datasets. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our proposed architecture outperforms traditional approaches in terms of accuracy, efficiency, and adaptability. Additionally, we discuss insights gained from this research and outline future directions for improving trust and reputation management in social clouds.

articleTitle: Role of Machine Learning Algorithms in Analysis of Crop Disease Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Crop disease detection is a vital field of agricultural research with the potential to have a big influence on sustainability and food security. The use of machine learning algorithms for agricultural disease identification has gained popularity recently because they provide a quicker and more precise way to recognise and diagnose crop illnesses. With an emphasis on several techniques including image processing, spectral imaging, and deep learning, this review article explores current advancements in crop disease diagnosis using machine learning. The study presents potential remedies to increase each approach’s precision and dependability while highlighting the difficulties and drawbacks of each. The review paper also examines dataset accessibility and usability, which are essential for developing and testing machine learning models. To address the issues of sustainable agriculture and food security, the review article underlines the need of ongoing research in crop disease detection.

articleTitle: Handwritten Text Recognition Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Handwriting text recognition which can be also called as HTR is an emerging topic. As we know it is easy for humans to recognize any sort of things or objects. And humans can also identify the handwriting of one other. Researchers in the field of handwriting basically focus on deep learning. This recognition of handwriting can be seen in digits, character and words. The focus of the project is on the words i.e., detection of the words. So, here is an approach where we first take the images as input, extract certain features and then predict the accuracy of the model. In this approach, the model is being created and then the accuracy of the model is taken and I try to implement the images in a few images of my own handwriting. This project includes a handwritten word which is being taken as an input and it is converted into digital form. The model which is basically used is the CNN. CNN helps in extracting the features of the images and solve the problems of handwriting recognition.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality in E-Commerce: Unveiling the Future of Online Shopping
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: This exploration paper explores the transformative eventuality of stoked reality(AR) in the field of e-commerce. The primary idea is to estimate consumer engagement and purchase opinions on the addition of stoked reality in e-commerce similar to seeing products in a real terrain and interacting with them through the camera. This exploration paper underscores the strategic significance of Augmented Reality (AR) in reshaping the geography of e-commerce. concentrated on elevating online shopping gests through the integration of AR in e-commerce businesses. The study also shows the market evaluation of AR in e-commerce and advocates for the relinquishment of AR technologies as imperative for businesses seeking to maintain competitiveness and effectively engage consumers in this evolving e-commerce paradigm.

articleTitle: The Survey on IoT based kit for smart farming
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: This survey paper presents a comprehensive analysis of 30 studies related to crop detection using machine learning and remote sensing technologies. The studies were conducted on various crops, including wheat, maize, rice, tomato, potato, soybean, and others, and utilized different sets of environmental factors such as humidity, temperature, soil pH, moisture, and nutrient content. The paper outlines the drawbacks and limitations of each model, such as the requirement for extensive training data, limited scalability, poor generalization, and high computational cost. The paper also discusses the different methodologies implemented, including deep learning, decision trees, random forests, support vector machines, and k-nearest neighbors. The datasets used in these studies were obtained from remote sensing, UAV imagery, and ground-based sensors. Overall, the paper provides valuable insights into the strengths and limitations of different machine learning models and remote sensing technologies for crop prediction, highlighting the need for further research in this area to improve the accuracy and scalability of these models.

articleTitle: Estimation of Corrosion of Iron Using Clustering Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Corrosion is a big threat to the functionality and structural integrity of materials based on iron, demanding robust estimation strategies for timely mitigation. The conventional methods of corrosion estimation are often based on empirical models which oversimplify the complex interactions between material and environmental factors. Clustering techniques have ability of identifying the relationships and patterns within datasets offering a promising possibility for taming corrosion estimation. The unsupervised technique allows for the examination of intrinsic structures within data which reveals hidden correlations in context of corrosion. This work addresses the challenge in corrosion estimation by establishing and comparing two different clustering models using K-means and the FCM (Fuzzy C-means) techniques in MATLAB. The study initiates with an exhaustive literature survey examining existing work based on corrosion. The aim here is to estimate corrosion levels in iron on the basis of environmental factors including moisture content, oxygen level, and temperature.

articleTitle: Recurrent Neural Network Based Backstepping Controller for Genesio-Tesi Chaotic System
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Fractional calculus has drawn a lot of interest lately for its application in modelling and managing real-world systems. Fractional order (FO) nonlinear strict feedback system suffers from tracking issues and unknown parameters. This nonlinear system includes internal parameter uncertainty and external disruptions. Therefore, this paper proposed a novel controller to enhance the stability in nonlinear system under actuator faults. Recurrent neural network (RNN) based backstepping controller is proposed in this work for FO nonlinear system. Backstepping controller are mostly used with nonlinear systems. The instability is approximated using adaptively coupled RNN in the controller. RNN estimates the corresponding nonlinear component in the control expression to reduce the error in the system. This proposed method is implemented in gensio-tesi chaotic system. Verification of proposed scheme is carried out in MATLAB tool. Results of proposed method are analyzed with existing method to show performance of this system.

articleTitle: Transforming Healthcare Delivery: An Android Application Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The android healthcare application is a creative and innovative application which is developed for android users. It provides smooth-running healthcare access for the users. Offering a thorough chain of features, it gives the user a chance to book blood tests and body checkups, schedule appointments with doctors, and providing the user’s medical history which includes the reports of the blood reports and test within a single platform. Moreover, it provides on-Demand services such as Ambulance and medical assistance which enables user to book ambulance swiftly and track the real-time location of the user only when the user enables it, ensuring the privacy and security of the user, providing medical assistance when needed. With user-friendly interface and rich functionalities, it aims to revitalize healthcare accessibility, promoting overall healthcare experience for the user.

articleTitle: Detection of Spam and Fraudulent calls Using Natural Language Processing Model
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The main problem is the amount of spam calls and SMS messages that are sent out, which can be bothersome, invasive, and even dangerous for the recipients. These could be unsolicited marketing messages, phishing efforts, or frauds. A lot of call and SMS blocking programs would need to access a user’s call history or personal information, which raises privacy and data security issues. It uses natural language processing (NLP) to catch spam and fraudulent calls and SMS messages in real time. This implies that consumers will receive instant security since it can recognize and react to such stuff as it is received. Call-E places a great emphasis on its dedication to user privacy. It makes sure that discussions stay totally anonymous by not collecting, storing, or recording any user data. This solves the privacy issues that many call and SMS filtering programs have. Call-E has special permissions to run in the background without interfering with calls or messages since it is a system app. It guards the user’s mobile experience like a silent sentinel, ready to act at any moment. Users can get real-time security from Call-E’s NLP-based technology, which is successful in detecting and blocking spam and deceptive information. Call-E stands apart from the competition by protecting user privacy. Conversations are private and anonymous because it doesn’t capture or store any user data. Call-E functions in the background without interfering with calls or messages, as it is a system app with privileged permissions that keeps the user’s mobile experience safe.

articleTitle: Optimising Fuel Efficiency of Vehicle Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Because of the negative effects fuel consumption has on the environment and the economy, car owners and operators are quite concerned about it. By anticipating fuel usage and understanding the variables that influence it, machine learning (ML) algorithms can be used to maximize fuel economy. This paper examines the optimization of fuel efficiency through the application of machine learning methods such as Random-Forest, Decision-trees and linear regression. An algorithm to manage the efficiency of fuel used by a vehicle by using multiple machine learning model such as Linear Regression, Decision-Tree, Random-Forest, XG-Boost for predicting the fuel consumption of the vehicles based on the given set of input values and predicting the output value which is the fuel consumption in Litre/100 km. For example, this paper used linear regression model, random forest regression model, decision tree regression model, and xg-boost model for predicting the fuel consumption of the Light Motor Vehicles (LMV) with an accuracy of 90.5%, 99.97%, 99.96%, and 99.96% respectively. All things considered, ML algorithms might drastically increase fuel economy. To create and test different machine learning models for optimizing fuel efficiency in various car types and operating environments, further study is nonetheless required.

articleTitle: Fashion Forward with AI Creations using GAN
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: This paper explores fashion line-ups based on GANs in a complex modern area of fashion recommendation and generation. The use of a fashion recommender system is of paramount importance in resolving such a subjective and complicated problem as fashion styles. There have been previous works that suggest using images as well as deep network-based feature sets in order to improve recommendation accuracy. Building upon these foundations, this study demonstrates a groundbreaking approach: fashionaware image representations trained on both pixel-level data as well as user feedback itself. The new technique surpasses conventional approaches like BPR and pre-trained visual features, demonstrating noticeable gains in recommenders’ performance. In addition, this study extends the frontiers of knowledge by including an innovative creative element into the realm of fashion. Consumers and products can use these models to develop other fashionable products based on their tastes and preferences. This is a significant step for fashion towards moving out of conventional consensus to offer and co-create new product proposals. More so, the essay looks into a combination of GANs and deep learning schemes in individualized clothing production. The suggested system creates custom fashion products informed by contemporary styles as well as users’ prior clothes selections. Such a personalised experience can be the best solution to increase fashion store sales and thus, this may be crucial for the fashion world. However, such research also includes the development and categorisation of image-based fashion recommenders based on computerized vision developments.

articleTitle: Can An Artificial Intelligence-Powered Humanoid Chatbot Be a Quality Service Enhancer in The Insurance Industry?
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: This study explores the applicability of integrating cutting-edge AI chatbots that resemble human-like interactions in the customer service area, drawing on the underlying ideas of technological readiness and anthropomorphism. The study uses 688 questionnaire responses using purposive sampling and structural equation modelling as part of its empirical research technique to learn more about how customers perceive and use AI-powered humanoid chatbots (AIPHC). The target respondents were those who had some prior experience of using chatbots. Using SmartPLS-SEM, the study determines whether anthropomorphism, i.e., AIPHC system-specific and customer personality-specific dimensions, can improve chatbot usage in the insurance sector. The results show that anthropomorphism positively influenced optimism and innovativeness but negatively impacted discomfort and security. Further optimism and innovativeness favourably impact AIPHC adoption. Insecurity had a significant negative impact, while discomfort was insignificant for AIPHC adoption. The results could help us better understand how technological readiness and system-specific theories like anthropomorphism can be used in sectors like insurance. The results highlight chatbots’ potential to raise the quality of service, simplify processes, and enhance customers’ overall experiences in the insurance sector.

articleTitle: Cardiovascular Ailment Prediction Machine Learning: A new era
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Heart disease is a serious disease that affects the heart. Since heart disease can be life-threatening, researchers are focusing on developing smart systems to accurately diagnose heart disease based on electronic medical records with the help of machine learning algorithms. This study presents several machine learning methods to predict heart disease using information about patients’ vital health status. This article introduces four classification methods: Multilayer Perceptron (MLP), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), and Naive Bayes (NB) for building predictive models. Complete the data preprocessing and feature selection steps before building the model. Today, machine learning (ML) plays an important role in disease prediction and is an important tool in medicine. In this research, study-based analysis was planned. Our aim is to create a good prediction model to predict cardiovascular diseases; This allows better SMOTE technology to show better results.. This study collected data to predict heart disease. It evaluates the accuracy of various machine learning techniques, including Naive Bayes, Random Forests, Decision Trees, Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machines, K-Nearest, and Gradient Boosting. Cardiovascular disease prediction; includes data comprehension, data analysis, and architecture. Researchers use heart disease data to great effect.

articleTitle: The Enigma of the Dark Web: A Duality of Unrestricted Liberty and Unlawfulness
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: In the age of modern technology, data privacy has become crucial for both individuals and organisations. Nevertheless, even the most advanced protective systems struggle to keep up with cybercriminals’ ever-evolving and inventive tactics. An indispensable instrument for proactively detecting and averting cyberattacks is dark-web threat intelligence. It gives organisations knowledge about the tactics and skills of their enemies, enabling them to create and put into place efficient security measures. The current status of dark-web threat intelligence is reviewed, along with the tools, tactics, and approaches employed by adversaries, as well as any potential obstacles or restrictions that may exist in this arena. The writers also discuss the future potential, moral ramifications, and technical challenges of dark-web threat intelligence.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Sentiment Analysis: Techniques, Datasets, Limitations, and Future Scope
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Sentiment analysis uses opinions from the public to analyze how people feel about a variety of social, political,and cultural issues. The review commences by outlining the fundamental concepts, significance, and approaches of sentiment analysis in comprehending viewpoints, feelings, and subjectivity contained within the text. This study considers two main types of techniques: machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), and ensemble learning (EL) to overcome existing limitations. By analyzing their effectiveness in decoding emotional complexities and achieving accurate predictions, this review provides insights on their utility. Additionally, it emphasizes commonly used datasets, serving as benchmarks to assess model robustness. With the aim of influencing future breakthroughs in sentiment analysis, this research contributes to the ongoing refinement of this dynamic field. Lastly, we have addressed some research challenges and outlined future directions, providing valuable insights for readers seeking to advance sentiment analysis methodologies.

articleTitle: A Research Model For Automated Prediction And Analysis Of Job Interview Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: One of the most important steps in the recruitment procedure is the interview. Job seekers typically practice with each other in mock interviews to ensure they are fully prepared for the interview with the recruiters. Trainee interviewers can learn and practice questioning techniques in a safe environment by using mock (simulated) interviews. Studies reveal that when mock interviews are designed in accordance with the body of scientific research on the best settings for learning for questioning skills, interviewers develop useful and enduring skills. However, earlier practice interviews conducted with peers are typically very different from the real interview process; for example, the fake interviewers may not always act properly or in a way that is representative of a real interview. Hence, in this work a research model for Automated prediction and analysis of job interview performance is presented. This analysis leverages advanced technology to provide students with a comprehensive and personalized mock interview experience. This innovative Sample Mock Interview Project revolutionizes the way candidates prepare for interviews. By offering a realistic, personalized, and insightful experience, it empowers users to refine their skills, boost their confidence, and excel in real-world interview situations. Additionally, users can get feedback on the manner in which they performed in the fake interview by using features like volume, head nodding, communication, and facial preference. The performance of presented mock interview is evaluated in terms of Tension Rate, Time Consumption and Practice Cost.

articleTitle: Multimodal Sentimental Analysis For Real-Time Monitoring of Work Stress Levels
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Stress at work is a widespread issue that affects both employee well-being and organizational productivity. Conventional techniques for evaluating stress frequently depend on subjective self-reporting, which provides little information on changes in stress levels in real-time. As a result, the incorporation of multimodal sentiment analysis has become a viable strategy for the ongoing, impartial tracking of stress at work. This survey study offers a thorough overview and comparison of previous studies on multimodal sentiment analysis for measuring job stress in real time. This literature review delves into the elements of multimodal sentiment analysis, comparing and contrasting it with conventional stress assessment techniques and scrutinizes the many methodologies utilized in recent research.An in-depth examination of the techniques and performance measures used in these studies provides valuable information on the advantages and disadvantages of various strategies. Research future directions are discussed in light of identified obstacles, such as sample size restrictions and applicability in varied work situations. The study closes with a summary of the most important discoveries, a discussion of the practical ramifications, and suggestions for furthering the topic. This comparative assessment paves the way for future research in this crucial area while also deepening our grasp of the state-of-the-art in multimodal sentiment analysis for real-time job stress monitoring.

articleTitle: Big Mart Sales Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Machine learning is a powerful technology that enables computer systems to recognize patterns and make prediction and choices without performing explicit programming. The basic notion behind this technology is to create models and algorithms that can take in input information, predict an outcome using statistical computation, and adjust outputs in response to fresh information. In this research paper, we examine the Big Mart Shopping Centre scenarios in order to forecast sales of various product categories and comprehend the impact of various factors on sales of various product categories. This paper focuses on leveraging machine learning techniques to predict sales for Big Mart with the aim of optimizing inventory management and maximizing revenue. Using a variety of characteristics from a dataset that Big Mart gathered, along with the methodology used to construct a prediction model, very accurate results are produced and these findings can be utilized to make decisions aimed at increasing sales and increase operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Face Classification Using Stacking Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Developing a high-level automated security system for identification/authentication has long been an active research subject in practically all fields. Traditional security systems utilize a key or a password to secure a process/product, whereas biometric security systems use a person’s physical or behavioral attributes. Face patterns play a significant part in several potential recognition/authentication applications because of their uniqueness, universality, dependability, and stability. This study provides a face identification system that starts with eye detection and ends with face image recognition. AN ensemble stacking approach for face classification is presented in this study that combines various Machine learning (ML) algorithms with and without Principal Component Analysis (PCA). The proposed system is trained and tested on a well-known publically available Olivetti Face Dataset. The dataset is split into 75% train and 25% test dataset which is also transformed using PCA. The results show that the accuracy of each base model having PCA data is on par or better than the one without PCA. The paper also proves that the performance of the new stacking ensemble system results in an average or better performance than the other base models. For Olivetti face dataset, the proposed Stacked Ensemble Learning model’s accuracy with PCA is 94%, which is on average than the accuracy of the other base models, including Neural Network (NN) (100%), Random Forest (92%), Support Vector Machine (SVM)(96%), Gaussian Naives Bayes(81%), K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN) (89%), and Logistic Regression (LR) (97%) respectively.

articleTitle: inQuery- Online AI Application Formatting and Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Written applications, with standardized fields like date, subject, sender and receiver, serve various purposes such as leave requests, misconduct appeals and suggestions. Surprisingly, even in today’s tech-driven world, these applications often remain paper-based, leading to repetitive tasks like leave requests and complaints, which can be time-consuming and inefficient. Managing paper applications also poses challenges like misplacement and physical storage needs.Our methodology addresses this by designing the application’s UI in Figma, exporting assets to Android Studio and creating a new project. In Android Studio, we implement the UI and functionality using these design assets, integrating Firebase services for authentication, real-time database and storage. Artificial Intelligence will be used for formatting the applications. We then test the application and ensure ongoing maintenance and updates.Our observations reveal that many institutions still rely on traditional application methods. We recommend institutions adopt online application writing and management systems, as demonstrated by our Android app, “inQuery: An Application for Applications,” simplifying and enhancing this process.

articleTitle: A Review: Cold Start Latency in Serverless Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The worldview of serverless computing addresses a significant evolutionary leap to smooth out the designer experience. Serverless computing, a feature of the cloud computing, seeks to ease the devlopers from the weights related with the server organization and essential infrastructure choices. Generally, it endeavors to satisfy its essential responsibility by releiving the designers from worries connected with server arrangement, setup, and scaling. The integration of FaaS plays a vital part in understanding the execution of serverless computing. This state of the art approach of the cloud computing works on application configuration, offering designers the capacity to evade server management through the reception of the ongoing Serverless Computing Paradigm. Working on a computational architecture that uses discrete functions as executables. These functions are sent exclusively on a serverless stage, giving quick adaptability per request to the clients. However, this adaptability frequently leads to the test known as the “Cold Starts”, where the delays happen during the task allocation to a runtime container. Presented by Amazon in 2014, AWS Lambda is one of the noticeable illustration of serverless computing architecture. Post-launch, different entities, incorporating both open-source and for benefit associations, embraced and popularized this innovation. Eminently, every platform tends to cold starts uniquely, provoking broad examination of every platforms performance under conditions comparable to the cold start in the recent years. This paper offers a top to bottom survey of the most recent progressions and cutting edge examinations in the space of serverless engineering for cold start interval reduction. By digging into the complexities of different platform performance and their ways to deal with the mitigation of the cold start challenge, this review aims to contribute significant insights to the continuous talk in the field of serverless computing.

articleTitle: Development and Execution of an IoT-Based Accident Detection and Alert System with Location Tracking
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Emergencies, by their very nature, are unpredictable and demand immediate action. Every second counts when lives are on the line, and rapid response is the cornerstone of effective emergency management. Unfortunately, around the world, countless lives are lost annually due to delays in rescue efforts. Automatic accident detection and alert systems with live location tracking have the potential to revolutionize road safety. By utilizing sensors to detect accidents and GPS modules to pinpoint the vehicle’s location, these systems can rapidly notify emergency responders, minimizing response time and maximizing the chances of survival for accident victims. The benefits of these systems extend beyond saving lives, as they can also reduce property damage, healthcare costs, and provide peace of mind to drivers. While the cost of these systems can vary depending on their features and capabilities, the potential benefits far outweigh the investment.

articleTitle: Role of artificial intelligence in the early detection of thrombocytopenia: An approach to improve health of pregnant women
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Thrombocytopenia, which is a blood disorder with a 7–12% frequency of platelet insufficiency, is frequently detected by obstetricians during normal surveillance during pregnancy. Obstetricians employ a platelet count < 150,000 mm3 as the defining threshold, and subsequent decisions regarding further investigation and management become crucial. While physiological changes, like gestational thrombocytopenia, constitute the majority of cases, there are other potential causes linked to serious illnesses that can pose risks to both the mother and fetus. Distinguishing between pregnancy-specific disorders (e.g., pre-eclampsia/HELLP syndrome) and non-pregnancy-specific ones (e.g., immune thrombocytopenia purpura, thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura, or hemolytic uremic syndrome) can be challenging. Recognizing symptoms and indicators becomes vital for choosing an appropriate course of inquiry. The severity, cause, and gestational age of thrombocytopenia influence different treatment regimens. This article offers a thorough review of the changing environment in the management of thrombocytopenia during pregnancy by summarizing both traditional and modern methods for thrombocytopenia detection and emphasizing the significance of artificial intelligence in early identification.

articleTitle: Efficacy of Customer Churn Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Customer churn, defined as customer defection is a big problem for businesses in today’s competition. This paper takes an in-depth look at the application of machine learning (ML) in customer churn prediction to identify the best models for various industries. quantitative performance metrics of seven commonly used machine learning algorithms: Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, Naive Bayes, K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), AdaBoost, and XGBoost. The theoretical background, application context, and performance evaluation of each model are examined, focusing on precision, accuracy, recall, and F1 score. Evaluation of the performance of the model on different business data is also done to ensure that the application is real in the world. This comparison shows the advantages and disadvantages of each model and guides providers in their selection based on the specific needs of the business and profile features. Additionally, this paper explores future changes in predictions and highlights the changing role of machine learning technologies, especially deep learning, in improving the accuracy of predictions and personalization. This review is very useful for professionals and experts; It provides a better understanding of the current machine learning model for customer churn prediction and provides insight into future research and practical applications.

articleTitle: Accuracy enhancement of Component based selection model using Hybrid Soft computing
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Accuracy enhancement of Component based selection model using Hybrid Soft computing Need of component based selection is growing day by day. There have been several researches in existence that analyzed existing component based selection model using soft computing techniques. Several research works focused on optimizing software component selection model in CBSE using soft computing techniques. Thus there is need to improve the performance of component based selection model using hybrid soft computing techniques. Several performance parameters are considered during data analytics operation. Organization tends to utilize mapping tools in order build sustainable designs for their processes as well as capabilities. During data analytics, acquisition, security, governance and standards, Insights and analysis, storage, visualization, optimization operation are performed. Proposed research has integrated PSO optimization technique with ANN based neural network to enhance the accuracy of component based selection model.

articleTitle: Drowning Human Detection Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Every year, a lot of people die in drowning situations, most of which go unreported. This work investigates the use of deep learning methods for real-time drowning detection in aquatic environments, with a focus on YOLOv5, YOLOv7, YOLOv8 and Faster RCNN. Our focus is on accuracy, speed, and resilience to underwater obstacles such as lighting fluctuations and camera motion. We train and assess these models on image datasets that include people who have drowned. In order to determine the best deep learning strategy for quick and accurate drowning detection—and maybe save lives by facilitating quicker emergency response in aquatic environments—we will compare the performance of various sophisticated YOLO architectures and Faster RCNN architectures. Through a detailed comparison of three state-of-the-art YOLO architectures and Faster RCNN architectures, authors want to determine which one emerges victorious in this pivotal naval conflict.

articleTitle: Mitigate the Man-in-the-Middle attack by the use of Machine Learning Techniques: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The wide use of Internet brought many challenges were security has become a need to protect information and resources against attacks such as Man-in-the-Middle (MITM). This type of attack aims to eavesdrop a communication between two or more legitimate entities without there awareness. Machine Learning (ML) algorithms combined with traditional approaches such Intrusion Detection System (IDS) and Firewalls are often adopted as solution to security concerns that this type of attack brings, were the accuracy of proposed schemes has shown how secure these approaches can be. The traditional approaches without an combined intelligent technique are normally deceived by the new type of unknown MITM attack due this the combination of intelligent computing techniques such ML can bring accuracy that achieve in the best scenario $98 \%$ of accuracy being possible to detect even unknown MITM attacks compared to other methodologies. Even though many studies performed in this attack, it continues bringing security concerns due the various reasons such vulnerabilities in communication channels that are continually exploited.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis on Cardiac and Diabetic Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Diabetes and cardiac conditions are essentially distinguished by elevated blood glucose levels and cardiovascular disorders, respectively. A diverse array of complex illnesses, including but not limited to heart attack, renal failure, and stroke, are associated with it. Diabetes has a global prevalence of over 422 million people in 2014, making it the most common metabolic disease on the planet. The primary objective of this study is to evaluate and compare the performance of Support Vector Machines (SVM), Decision Trees, Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), and k-nearest Neighbors (KNN) in classifying diabetes and cardiac patients using a specific dataset. The present study serves as a roadmap for future research in predictive analytics for cardiac and diabetes ailments by analyzing current literature and identifying research gaps. The primary objective is to create the way for the generation of robust, accessible, and clinically feasible ML models that can significantly contribute to the early identification and management of these common health conditions, thus enhancing the outcomes of patients as well as decreasing the burden on healthcare systems around the world. Models based on supervised learning algorithms have been discussed along with other interesting findings that are important in developing overall understanding of model for disease prediction algorithms.
