This study carefully assesses the selected papers and finds gaps in the current literature that will be helpful for researchers to develop and use in clinical domains, especially on heart and diabetic disease data sets. This study will also help medical professionals to identify cardiac and diabetic risks in advance, enabling them to take preventive actions.

articleTitle: Detection and Classification of Potholes using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Potholes on roads are a common problem that leads to accidents and damage to vehicles. Detecting potholes using computer vision techniques can help address this issue. In this paper, we propose a method for pothole detection using Convolutional Neural Networks. We train a CNN model on a dataset of road images, with labeled pothole and non-pothole regions. The trained algorithms, specifically ResNetV2, ResNet50, VGG19, and YOLOv8, for the task of pothole detection and capable of accurately classifying different regions in road images as either pothole or non-pothole areas.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Insights: Deciphering Consumer Behavior from Twitter Trends and Tweets
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Social Media currently dominates, so businesses require comprehending and anticipating customer behavior should they desire continued competitiveness. This research explores the analysis of Twitter data implementing refined machine learning algorithms such as LogisticRegression and Multinomial Naïve Bayes for identifying patterns and inclinations within the vast tweet volumes. The objective comprises bridging the divide between specific tweets and broader consumer conduct, thereby providing informative marketing and strategic decision-making insights. Through deploying cutting-edge machine learning capabilities, the method put forth forecast customer behavior deriving from Twitter with 92% accuracy. Conducting extensive dataset examinations enables noticing minute language, emotional, and interactive alterations contributing to trend formations. The multidimensional approach undertaken accounts for factors including timeliness, contextual data, and user demographics. By extracting revelatory features from the messages, the machine learning models exhibited proficiency for unveiling patterns potentially undetected via conventional analytical techniques. The considerable accuracy attained showcases profound learning’s latent capacity to glean meaningful understandings from the noisy, mercurial social media landscape. This study adds to the continuing conversation about using social media data to make strategic decisions in the modern corporate environment by clarifying the complex link between messages and consumer behavior.

articleTitle: Unveiling Consumer Behavior Patterns: A Comprehensive Market Basket Analysis for Strategic Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: This research employs Market Basket Analysis to gain strategic insights into the intricate world of consumer behavior. As customer preferences and industry trends constantly evolve, it is vital for companies looking to gain a competitive edge to fully grasp the multilayered patterns influencing purchase choices. The study takes a comprehensive approach to Market Basket Analysis, leveraging sophisticated data analytics to uncover subtle associations between products in shoppers’ carts. By scrutinizing item co-occurrence in transaction data, the analysis illuminates the interdependencies at play in customer decisions, examining relationships between products that customers regularly buy together. Utilizing algorithms such as Apriori enables the identification of previously unnoticed connections and the derivation of association rules that identify key drivers of consumer purchasing. The exhaustive Market Basket Analysis generated insightful findings, successfully ascertaining pivotal product pairings. For unraveling the convoluted factors impacting consumer behavior, this research paper offers an invaluable resource for academics, business experts, and practitioners. By taking an integrated approach to evaluating market baskets, companies can gain profound insight into customer preferences, empowering informed, strategic choices even as markets continue to transform rapidly.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Real-time Waste Management System with Dust Segregation & Full Bin Notifications
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The concept of automation as it relates to waste management systems falls under the purview of cleanliness and hygiene in this study. All growing nations have a common trend of disposing of rubbish in public places and on roadways, which usually damages the environment and creates a number of harmful conditions. In order to address these issues The term “smart dustbin” refers to a concept that combines hardware and software technologies, such as adding a Wi-Fi system to a regular trash can to provide users with free internet access for a certain amount of time. By rewarding the user for maintaining a clean environment, technology and proper waste management in a community go hand in hand. A smart dustbin uses a variety of technologies. The technology that measures the amount of trash dumped comes first, followed by the waste’s movement, and last, the ability to deliver vital messages and establish a connection between the user and the Wi-Fi system. Using a moisture sensor, the proposed system would additionally distinguish between solid and wet dust. The suggested system would run on a client-server architecture, which promises a healthy environment, a society free of pollution, and good health.

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis of a Multimodal biometric System using Preprocessing and Feature Extraction Techniques and Their Impact on Analytical Results
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Data preprocessing describes a collection of methods for improving the quality of the raw data, such as missing value imputation and outlier elimination. We delve into the significance of pre-processing in improving data quality, addressing issues related to noise, missing values, outliers, and other anomalies. The paper also discusses the impact of pre-processing on different types of data, including numerical, categorical, and textual data. This research paper presents a detailed case study where we applied various preprocessing techniques to a real-world dataset. The study investigates the effects of these techniques on data quality and the subsequent impact on analytical outcomes. By showcasing our own pre-processing results, the research aims to provide practical insights and recommendations for researchers and practitioners engaged in data analysis.

articleTitle: A login confirmation mechanism for meeting platforms with an automatic face acknowledgment system
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: In the current digital era, video conferencing has gained popularity as a means of conducting meetings and online conversations, and several software firms now provide solutions for the same. Numerous industries, including meetings, webinars, and online schools, employ this technology. Nevertheless, the majority of the time, these apps use email to send users login credentials, meeting links, and other information. All attendees receive the URL from the host and can use it to access the meeting. The fact that anyone with the connection can attend the meeting even if they haven’t been invited is a significant problem with this approach. If a user shares their login information with someone else, there is still a chance of unauthorized access even if usernames and passwords are taken into account as authentication mechanisms. If the user gives someone else access to their login information. The conference’s security and privacy may be at risk because of this. Sometimes it’s necessary to restrict access to particular audiences. For example, you might only let personnel working on a particular project or select students to attend meetings. This is the point at which an improved authentication technique is useful. We can greatly improve security and privacy in online meeting platforms by integrating facial recognition technologies. Once the facial recognition authentication system verifies them, only the intended attendees will be able to enter the meeting. The four stages of this system are participant entry, face detection, face recognition, and database construction. For face recognition, we can utilize the Local Binary Pattern Histogram technique with the Haar-Cascade classifier. By using this method, we can prevent unwanted attendees from joining the meeting.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Collaborative Task Assistance Mobile Application with Reward System
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: In an era characterized by an increasing reliance on mobile applications, this research paper presents the design and implementation of a user-friendly mobile application aimed at assisting individuals in completing tasks while fostering a collaborative community. The application incorporates a reward system to incentivize both task providers and seekers, creating a mutually beneficial environment. The research explores existing task assistance applications, identifies gaps in current solutions, and introduces a comprehensive approach to address these challenges. The methodology encompasses user feedback, usability testing, and a robust technological framework to ensure an intuitive and engaging user experience. The paper discusses the application’s architecture, features, and the integration of a reward system to encourage active participation. Results from usability testing and user feedback provide insights into the application’s effectiveness, paving the way for a collaborative environment that supports diverse user needs. The implications of this research extend to the potential enhancement of user support mechanisms and the creation of a supportive community through innovative mobile technology.

articleTitle: Classification of Plant Disease using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The identification of plant diseases has become a key topic in smart agriculture research in recent years. The productivity of agricultural products will undoubtedly increase with early plant disease identification. For the farmers, it is difficult to determine the specific diseases affecting the plant leaves. Therefore, the development of an automated system becomes an essential practice for detecting diseases. So that the remedies can be suggested according to the disease’ s severity. In this situation, image processing methods combined with Machine Learning (ML) algorithms have lately offered an accurate and dependable way of identifying and categorizing many plant diseases. Hence, this work investigates the importance of the deployment of various ML algorithms such as Naïve Bayes (NB), Decision Tree (DT), Artificial Neural Networks (ANN), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), and Support Vector Machine (SVM) in automatic classification of plant diseases on the benchmark plant village dataset.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Study on Optimization Techniques for Microservices Deployment
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: With the emergence of high-speed internet, web traffic is spiking gradually. People are opting for different optimization frameworks to develop their enterprise level applications. To meet the modern demand of high fault tolerance reliability and low latency, the traditional approach of monolithic application deployment needs to be replaced with the micro service deployment approach. This offers a wide range of benefits with the involvement of modern cloud computing like serverless and multi-cloud architecture. With the implementation of microservice, there is the requirement of automated management of microservice which is done by the orchestration tools. With these advances in technology, there are several complex challenges. This paper uncovers how different techniques help in addressing these modern deployment issues and how the modern approach is drifted towards the high computational availability and low costing. Through the review of recent research and advancements in this area, this paper presents an effective study on microservice deployment and orchestration challenges along with their proposed solutions. This review also highlights the synergic impact of modern orchestration tools like Docker and Kubernetes.

articleTitle: An efficient clustering algorithm for image segmentation of retinal OCT images
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Successful automated diagnosis of diabetes inflicted retinal disease is based on a fast and precise clustering algorithm to improve the view of retinal layers with respect to background. This study proposes an improved k-means clustering algorithm for segmentation of retinal scans, which is able to improve analysis and diagnosis of retinal pathology. The novelty of this work is in the application of the structural similarity feature with a clustering algorithm. The algorithm provides four clusters of pixels as a result, out of which the most suitable clustering arrangement is selected for segmentation with respect to the background. The algorithm benefits most in cases where the pathology-generated features tend to lie in different clusters in different OCT images. This algorithm provides more precise segmentation as compared to using the clustering algorithm alone without increasing the computational complexity or time required for segmentation significantly.

articleTitle: Multi-resource balance Virtual Machine Consolidation Based on Extreme Learning Machine and Improved Grey Wolf Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: In today’s rapidly evolving computing landscape, Cloud Data Centers (CDCs) play a crucial role in reshaping IT infrastructure deployment and management. Despite widespread adoption, many CDCs operate below optimal capacity, leading to higher power consumption and operating expenses. The ongoing challenge is to efficiently balance resource utilization, conserve energy, and ensure a high standard of Quality of Service (QoS). Current research often focuses on minimizing power usage through aggressive VM consolidation, which can result in SLA breaches and resource wastage due to unusable resource fragmentation. This study addresses the challenge by introducing the EML_IGWO algorithm, which combines the predictive capabilities of the Extreme Learning Machine (ELM) algorithm for forecasting host states, a multi-resource balance index for effective management of multidimensional resources, and the Improved Grey Wolf Optimizer (IGWO) for adeptly selecting the equilibrium solution from the Pareto frontier. The integrated approach aims to optimize both resource utilization and energy consumption, striking a suitable compromise between the conflicting objectives of SLA violation and power consumption. Experimental results, based on a real dataset in CloudSim and benchmark comparisons, highlight the algorithm’s outstanding performance across all metrics.

articleTitle: RideGuard: Empowering Rider Safety with Integrated Helmet Technology and Aid App
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: With the increased usage of two-wheeler vehicles, traffic accidents are being recorded at an alarming rate each year. This research paper introduces RideGuard, an innovative helmet project designed to enhance rider safety by integrating advanced sensors and accelerometers. The core focus of this research is the development of a notification and aid system app, seamlessly integrated with the RideGuard helmet which is able to detect alcohol levels and accident in real-time. In the event of an accident, the system automatically triggers alerts to nearby hospitals and the rider’ s designated emergency contacts, including family members. This timely notification aims to expedite emergency response, potentially reducing the severity of injuries and improving overall outcomes. The RideGuard app is designed with user-friendly interfaces, enabling efficient communication between the helmet and the user’ s smartphone. The app provides real-time status updates, ensuring users are informed about their safety and the system’ s functionality. The integration of GPS technology enhances the accuracy of accident location detection, facilitating a quicker response from emergency services.

articleTitle: Unveiling Machine Learning Paradigms for Robust Malware Detection in Personal Data Security
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: In the world of computers and software, data is an asset; a personal, valuable, and important component in every person’s life. Malware used to extract hidden and personal data is slowly spreading around the globe. Conventional signature-based malware detection techniques are finding it difficult to keep up with the constant growth of malware. A viable substitute is machine learning (ML), which can recognize intricate patterns and adjust to new threats. This study compares 11 different Machine Learning models, to find the best model that can detect malware. The algorithms are trained and tested on a dataset called TUNADROMD with and without using Principle Component Analysis (PCA). The Random Forest is found to be the best-performing model with and without PCA with accuracies of 0.99 and 0.98 respectively. The worst-performing model is found to be Logistic Regression both with and without PCA with accuracies of 0.98 and 0.81 respectively.

articleTitle: Emergency Message Prioritization and Scheduling in Vehicular Ad hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Vehicular Ad hoc network (VANET) is a subclass of Mobile Ad hoc networks (MANET). With the increasing deployment of Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) and VANET have become essential for improving road safety and communication among vehicles. In this study, it leverages the ns-2 simulator to investigate the effectiveness of emergency message scheduling strategies in VANETs under various mobility scenarios. This simulation model incorporates a dynamic network environment with vehicles employing the Destination-Sequenced Distance Vector (DSDV) routing protocol and IEEE 802.11p MAC layer. Emergency messages, crucial for timely response to critical events on the road, are scheduled using a proactive scheduling mechanism. The simulation considers scenarios where vehicles dynamically adjust their trajectories based on real-time traffic conditions. The work evaluates the impact of different emergency message scheduling strategies on network performance metrics, including throughput, packet delay, and packet loss. The simulation also explores the trade-offs between high-priority emergency messages and regular communication traffic, here it tries to reduce the Road accidents and prevent congestion by improving VANET Connectivity.

articleTitle: Green Blockchain technology for Organization Performance without Risky Activities: Natural-Resource-Based View
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Implementing the idea based on natural resources-based view theory, the research looks at the influence of pollution prevention strategies, green blockchain technology, and energy saving on an organization’s environmental orientation. Further, the association between the organization’s environmental exposure and the organization performance is verified. In addition, it explores moderating effect of firm’s risk-taking on the association between ecological orientation and firm performance. Hypotheses are tested using structural equation modeling and moderation analysis on the primary data collected from 231 employees working in different industries. The findings highlight that the capabilities of pollution prevention and green blockchain technology are prerequisites to formulating environmental orientation. The results confirm that the organization’s environmental orientation impacts performance outcomes. The results of the moderation process show that the association between environmental orientation and company performance is moderated by risk-taking. The study advances knowledge of pollution prevention, green blockchain technologies, and energy-saving perspectives based on natural resources that shape the environmental orientation of businesses. These results offer significant management implications for the utilization of environmental resources to achieve business performance goals.

articleTitle: Unleashing the Role of Artificial Intelligence on Entrepreneurship
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Artificial intelligence is the surveillance of devices or software, as opposed to the intellect of humans or other animals. It is a sphere of learning in mainframe science that develops and acquires skills in intelligent machines. These machines may be called AIs. These are widely used throughout industry, government, and science. It is the inducement of human intelligence by machines, specifically processed by machines. These leverage computers and machines to mimic the problem-solving and decision-making capabilities of the human mind. This is the ability of a computer-controlled robot to perform activities commonly linked with intelligent beings. Artificial intelligence is involved in every sphere and makes every activity easier than before. This is helping in the entrepreneurial world also and enhancing all the tasks or activities of entrepreneurship. Entrepreneurs are lowering their workforce requirements, reducing operational costs, and enhancing overall efficiency. So, this research will draw your attention to the role of artificial intelligence in entrepreneurship through bibliometric analysis. For this analysis, the Scopus literature database from 2013-2024 has been selected. All the selected papers are in the final stage and of open access. In this paper, a few of the tools of artificial intelligence will also be narrated that are helping and enhancing the entrepreneurial field. Moreover, some of the top entrepreneurs using artificial intelligence are also listed in this paper.

articleTitle: Epidermis Bruise Analysis Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Among the most vital organs that protect the body of a human from the external environment is the skin. Early skin illness identification is essential for reducing mortality because it prevents skin cancer, and any other skin disease from developing. But because it resembles skin patches, insect bites etc in appearance, early detection that might lengthen life expectancy is a fantastic experiment. We would be working with different skin diseases namely ‘Acne’, ‘Eczema or Atopic Dermatitis’, ‘melanoma’. A working model that uses image analysis and machine learning to classify and identify skin conditions. A brand-new, cutting edge automated system that can swiftly and accurately identify skin lesions is needed to deal with biomedical pictures. There is growing curiosity concerning the application of deep learning to the diagnosis and management of different diseases. For the early detection of skin disease, we therefore suggested a deep learning model based on CNN and the merger of the U-Net and ResNet models is presented as a fusion model that has been used to perform encoding decoding of the disorders using skin scans. This model integrates image processing, image enhancement, machine learning and segmentation techniques. The model yielded an overall accuracy of 95.6%. Incorporate additional skin conditions in the future to strengthen our model’s suitability for medical applications.

articleTitle: A Review of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques for Saffron Adulteration Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: One of the most expensive spices, saffron, commonly known as the “golden spice,” is grown primarily in Iran, Greece, Spain, China, and India (mostly in Kashmir valley). However, because of its low output and high cost, it is frequently contaminated, which causes financial loss and a number of health problems. Sunflower, safflower, maize outer layer, and hibiscus stigmas are some of the adulterants that are combined with authentic saffron samples to boost its yield. Nowadays, the menace of saffron adulteration is one of the major issues that needs further attention as human vision fails to discriminate between pure and adulterated saffron samples. Hence, an intelligent computer vision-enabled saffron adulteration prediction system is used by researchers to overcome this issue. In this paper, we present a novel framework for saffron adulteration prediction using intelligent data-driven approaches. Moreover, various pre-processing techniques are used to enhance the quality of saffron images. Besides, we demonstrate the comparative analysis of recent saffron adulteration prediction techniques and identify certain open research issues that needs futuristic attention. In addition, performance protocols such as performance metrics and saffron images-based dataset are briefly illustrated. Our analysis reveals that this study provides researchers with new directions that needs to be addressed in future and can potentially prevent economic loss and ensure consumer safety.

articleTitle: Smart Parking Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: This paper brings forward an automated and real-time smart parking management system using low-cost IoT infrastructure that collects parking status with sensors dispatched to different parking spaces. They transmit the parking status to the AWS IoT platform, automated using solar panel energy. The AWS IoT Core handles all incoming messages from the IoT system to integrate the information collected into the AWS DynamoDB database using the AWS lambda function. Administrators can manage the parking spaces, by performing some CRUD operations on a mobile application, developed using Ionic Framework. The administrators can have real-time visibility on the number of free and occupied parking spaces, with detailed information about parking status and parking occupants. A navigation GPS tracker system and a parking search engine are also provided on the applications to easily obtain parking spaces around Mauritius.

articleTitle: Leaf Disease Detection Using OpenCV And Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Plants play a role in maintaining the food source, yet plant diseases can lead to a significant decrease in production, As the world’s population continues to grow, increasing crop production is vital to ensure food safety and security for all. Unfortunately, numerous plant diseases can undermine the supply of essential crops. Therefore, it is essential to identify and monitor these diseases on a large scale. However manual monitoring by agriculture specialists and botanists is difficult time consuming and prone to mistakes. To tackle this issue this research suggests a system for identifying leaf diseases using OpenCV, a computer vision library known for its effectiveness, in detecting plant ailments. The proposed system offers numerous benefits, including high accuracy and ease of implementation, making it a cost-effective means of detecting and managing plant diseases. By implementing this system, it is possible to reduce economic losses for farmers and improve crop yields. Tomato is a popular fruit(vegetable) belonging to the nightshade family. It comes in different shapes, sizes, and colors such as red, yellow, and green. In agriculture, tomato plants are prone to various diseases, including Target Spot, Late Blight, and Yellow Leaf Curl Virus. To tackle this, we classified ten common tomato diseases and trained a model using a dataset of 15,600 images. Our model achieved an accuracy ranging from 91.25% to 93.9%. which can help farmers detect and treat diseases at an early stage, improving crop yields and reducing losses.

articleTitle: Assessing the Practical Implications of Integrating Blockchain Technology into Human Resource Management in Digital Era: An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Blockchain technology has the potential to revolutionize HRM procedures, but its impact on hiring, onboarding, and performance reviews remains unknown. This study uses a quantitative research approach, involving an employee, organizational leader, and HR professional survey, to quantify the influence of blockchain on HR productivity, assess its protection of confidential HR information, and improve personnel management transparency. Confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) and structural equation modelling (SEM) are used to examine data from businesses that have integrated blockchain technology into their HRM systems. The results show that blockchain effectively protects HR data, ensures privacy, and enhances transparency in employee records, certifications, and career advancement tracking. Transparency is the second most important factor correlated with blockchain adoption, after privacy. These findings provide valuable advice for businesses considering or navigating the use of blockchain technology in HR administration. Future research should focus on off-boarding procedures, such as updating employment records, managing payroll, and conducting exit interviews.

articleTitle: Unlocking the Potential of IoT Technologies in the Era of Industry 4.0 Digital Economy: An Exploration of the Transformative Impact
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Business operations have undergone a considerable transition because of the Fourth Industrial Revolution or Industry 4.0. The Internet of Things (IoT) and the proliferation of connected gadgets have made the digital economy more dynamic and complicated. The introduction of the study provides an outline of Industry 4.0 and the salient features that characterise this period. The article then goes into detail on Industry 4.0’s use of IoT technologies and how such technologies are altering every aspect of business operations, from manufacturing to logistics and supply chain management. The report also looks at some of the issues with data security and privacy that enterprises have when deploying IoT technologies. The article provides case studies of companies that have effectively deployed IoT technology to help readers comprehend the transformative effects of these technologies. These case studies demonstrate how IoT technologies have helped businesses grow more productive, spend less money, and provide better customer service. In addition, the report looks at prospective IoT applications for Industry 4.0, like predictive maintenance and smart cities. Overall, this article offers a thorough review of the industry 4.0 digital economy’s transformational effects of IoT technology. It emphasises the potential advantages that companies can gain from these technologies as well as the difficulties they must overcome to reach their full potential.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Personalized Medicine: Transforming Healthcare Privacy and Tailoring through Interoperability Standards and Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Personalized medicine holds immense potential for transforming healthcare by tailoring treatments to individual patients, but its realization is hindered by privacy concerns and data fragmentation. This review explores the intersection of healthcare privacy and personalization, focusing on interoperability standards and federated learning. It discusses personalized medicine’s historical context, challenges, and evolution. The role of interoperability standards and privacy-preserving federated learning is examined. Privacy concerns, ethical considerations, and legal challenges in healthcare are addressed. The benefits of personalized medicine in improving outcomes, enhancing data security, and achieving cost-effectiveness are highlighted. Emerging technologies in healthcare data management are also discussed. The review underscores the potential of these technologies and the need for continued research and innovation to harmoniously integrate healthcare privacy and personalization.

articleTitle: A Review on Medicinal Plant identification through Leaf Image
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: With a long history of successful healing interventions, the world’s first scientific medical system was Ayurveda, an ancient medical science from India. Ayurveda dates back to the Vedic period, more than $\mathbf{5 0 0 0}$ years ago. Indian System of Medicine is the name given to Ayurveda medicine in India. It is estimated that $\mathbf{8 0}$ percent of people worldwide still use traditional systems. It is also common knowledge that the chemical components of plants have their origins in allopathic medications. The importance of automated information extraction, analysis, and retrieve for medicinal plants has lately increased based on visual characteristic studies. This is due to the two primary problems with manual identification and processing of herbal medications, namely the lack of expertise and subjectivity present in the practitioners of Ayurveda. Therefore, effective computer software is required by biologists and practitioners of Ayurveda to automatically extract and analyze the key information from photographs of medicinal plants. This paper represents a review on medicinal plant identification through leaf images.

articleTitle: Security and privacy in the blockchain-Internet of Things hybrid system for a healthcare database network
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The healthcare industry is experiencing a surge in anxieties related to patient records and computerized medical practices. New, more secure ways of monitoring and exchanging medical data are one of several services made possible by integrating the IoT with blockchain technology. Central to this system is the idea of data blocks, which, if filled, can hold whole datasets before being sealed and linked to create a data chain. A secure and highly precise technique of data storage is established in this study without the need for any external system. By using blockchain technology to an advanced healthcare system, our research demonstrates how other technologies may be integrated to create a fully automated and secure record-serving system, capitalizing on current trends and opportunities.

articleTitle: Skin Cancer Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Skin cancer, a global health threat, demands rapid and precise diagnosis for optimal outcomes. This research tackles this challenge by presenting an automated system powered by deep learning, specifically the DenseNet 169 model, trained on the rich Skin Cancer: Malignant vs Benign dataset.Early detection is critical, and our system excels in this area. Leveraging dermoscopy images, DenseNet169 categorizes skin lesions with remarkable accuracy, achieving a staggering $\mathbf{8 9. 7 \%}$ success rate. Our model surpasses established models and even outperforms human dermatologists in some instances.Our research marks a significant leap forward in automated skin cancer diagnosis. By integrating seamlessly with healthcare workflows, this system can empower medical professionals, saving lives and alleviating strain on healthcare systems. This research paves the way for a future where AI assists in the fight against skin cancer, empowering healthcare professionals and improving patient well-being.

articleTitle: A Profound Review of AI-Driven Crime Detection in CCTV Videos
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) surveillance systems are widely utilized in public and private areas in order to increase public safety, such as shopping malls, markets, banks, hospitals, universities, schools, streets, and residential apartments. The accuracy and time to detect and identify the crime and criminal are usually the major goals of security applications. However, because of varying environmental factors, the complexities of human activity, the ambiguous nature of the anomaly, and the absence of appropriate datasets, detecting video anomalies is challenging. This paper surveys the last five years, a comprehensive study of detecting crime from videos, and the recently used dataset. Moreover, a comparison study on different approaches has been performed, which are used for anomalies detection such as crime detection, theft, burglary, violence, street crime, shoplifting and unauthorized access. We have noticed that many deep learning algorithms has outperformed other methods in this field

articleTitle: AI Doctors in Healthcare: A Comparative Journey through Diagnosis, Treatment, Care, Drug Development, and Health Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare represents a transformative shift, offering unprecedented opportunities to revolutionize diagnostics, treatment, and patient care. It is a paradigm change in the healthcare industry. This study offers a thorough analysis of current developments in AI applications in a range of healthcare fields. Key findings are revealed through a review of groundbreaking research, demonstrating AI’s capacity to improve clinical decision-making, customize therapies, and improve diagnostic accuracy. From using deep learning for drug development to using explainable AI for leukemia diagnosis, each paper clarifies specific approaches and difficulties. This study highlights the enormous potential of AI to enhance patient outcomes and transform healthcare delivery paradigms by looking at its role in treatment optimization, clinical decision support, and healthcare data analysis.

articleTitle: Fake Profile Detection on Social sites
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: In the present day, social networking has become a vital part of our daily lives. It has significantly shaped our lifestyle, with online platforms and social networking websites playing a crucial role. These platforms have made it incredibly convenient to make friends and stay connected with people. However, amidst these remarkable advancements, issues related to fraudulent accounts and online deception have become more prominent. In our project, we’ve developed a framework that allows us to distinguish between genuine and fake profiles on these social networks. To achieve this, we’ve used a variety of classification techniques, such as Random Forest, Support Vector Machines, and Artificial Neural Networks, to categorize these accounts as either real or fake. This framework can be incredibly valuable for online social networks that have millions of profiles to manage. It’s especially useful because it automates the process of detection, eliminating the need for manual examination of each profile. This innovation can greatly enhance the security and trustworthiness of online social communities.

articleTitle: Chronic kidney disease prediction: Optimization of machine learning algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: A wide range of variables, such as more drinking, a growing worldwide pollution trouble caused on by rapid industrialization and warming temperatures, release of toxic gases from polluted water and food, misuse of drugs, and, most importantly, bad habits, are expected to make kidney failure worse. It is one of the deadliest illnesses affecting the world’s medical care systems. These factors ultimately lead to a constant rise in the number of kidney anomalies that patients are diagnosed with. Building classification and prediction models for early liver disease diagnosis involves examining the patient’s renal datasets. The disease is predicted using machine learning in an attempt to lighten the burden on physicians. This research investigates many past machine-learning algorithms for the diagnosis and categorization of renal disorders. A comparative examination of more than six models suggests the best course of action for the target dataset. For offline challenges, these are the greatest options for improving the accuracy of the model. While there is evidence to show that different ensemble procedures and hyper parameter tuning can lead to improved accuracy, these methods significantly raise computing productivity costs, rendering them impractical for real-world applications.

articleTitle: Customized Vision ARM for Segregation of Packages with Smart Picking
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The e-commerce company has experienced a substantial surge in growth, attributed to the implementation of automation technologies. Automation ensures the accurate delivery of packages to their designated destinations, but there are several domains that require human intervention. Sortation is a problem for many e-commerce companies. Collecting a package from a batch of shipments and placing it onto the conveyor belt is still challenging for automation systems. This paper presents a logistical robotic system integrated with grabbing, handling, and placement functions in warehousing scenarios. The model utilizes various motors to manage multiple moving parts and ensure mechanical integrity. The Raspberry Pi, coupled with computer vision, is used to identify and approach the package meant to be selected. Additionally, the model improves the speed and accuracy of the pick-and-place process and permits secure handling of packages by humans while maintaining distance. The proposed model provides a potentially revolutionary solution to enhance the reliability and strength of automation systems in the e-commerce sector. It has the potential to fundamentally change how sorting and segregation are done in the future.

articleTitle: Multilingual Cross-Modal Image Synthesis with Text-Guided Generative AI
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: Multilingual Cross-Modal Image Synthesis with Text-Guided Generative AI represents a groundbreaking exploration at the nexus of artificial intelligence, natural language processing, and computer vision. This research project harnesses advanced technologies, including TensorFlow, GAN, Diffusion Model, Hugging Face Transformers, CUDA, and OpenCV, to develop an innovative AI system capable of generating diverse visual content across multiple languages based on textual descriptions. By leveraging deep learning models and multilingual datasets, the project seeks to create a robust and adaptable solution, presenting a paradigm shift in the synthesis of visual elements guided by linguistic inputs. This research not only addresses the technical challenges in multilingual content synthesis but also contributes to the broader landscape of AI and machine learning. Through meticulous analysis, implementation, and critical evaluation, the project aims to provide a comprehensive understanding of the capabilities and limitations of the developed AI system. The outcomes of this research have the potential to impact diverse fields, from multimedia content creation to cross-cultural communication, opening new horizons for the integration of language and visual elements in artificial intelligence.

articleTitle: A Bibliometric Analysis of the Use of Technology for the Marketing of Online Pharmacies
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: In order to thoroughly investigate the scholarly landscape around the use of artificial intelligence (AI) in online pharmacies’ marketing techniques, this research article does a thorough bibliometric analysis. This study attempts to uncover important trends, prominent research issues, prolific authors, and the growth of knowledge in this particular junction of artificial intelligence and pharmaceutical marketing through the use of modern bibliometric methodologies. The process of the methodology is the methodical extraction of pertinent scholarly literature from reliable databases, which is then followed by the bibliometric analysis of co-authorship networks, thematic content, and citation patterns. The study uses visualization technologies to map the intellectual structure and distribution of information, and it spans a time period to capture the chronological progress of research in this field.Finding landmark studies, new research areas, and gaps in the body of knowledge about the use of AI in online pharmacy marketing is the aim of the analysis. In order to demonstrate the collaborative networks influencing this subject and the course of research evolution over time, the study will identify significant authors and institutions. The results of this bibliometric analysis add to our understanding of the state of research on artificial intelligence as it relates to online pharmacy marketing. The knowledge acquired can direct study agendas, shape future investigations, and provide insightful viewpoints for practitioners and policymakers working at the nexus of artificial intelligence, marketing, and healthcare.

articleTitle: A Review On Heart Disease Detection Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: In recent times, heart diseases have emerged as a notable factor contributing to mortality at a global level. Accurate prediction of heart disease is of utmost importance to improve patient outcomes and reduce mortality rates. Heart attacks occur due to coronary artery disease and chronic heart failure. Angiography is a common way to diagnose heart disease. Nowadays, researchers are focusing a lot on cardiovascular diseases. Using Machine Learning, a better diagnostic process is created. Machine learning gives more accurate and efficient results, helping spot heart disease in the early stages. Through this review paper, we aim to provide a comprehensive literature survey on the topic of heart disease prediction using ML algorithms.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Approach to Industry 4.0 Security: Blockchain and Dynamic Access Control Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: The advancement of various technologies has catapulted the modern industry into a transformative era commonly known as Industry 4.0. This novel technological landscape, characterized by 24 -hour connectivity, poses inherent vulnerabilities to cyber-attacks and unwanted access. To mitigate these security challenges, this paper introduces a robust access control framework tailored for Industry 4.0 environments. The proposed solution leverages the power of Hyperledger Fabric’s chaincode technology and implements a dynamic access control mechanism based on device attributes. Through the integration of these two components, the framework provides a flexible and granular approach to access management, ensuring the secure and efficient operation of interconnected industrial systems. This paper aims to explore the intricacies of the proposed access control framework, shedding light on its architecture, implementation details, and the dynamic interplay between chaincode and attribute-based access control. Through a comprehensive examination of this novel approach, we seek to contribute to the ongoing discourse on securing Industry 4.0 environments, offering a flexible and adaptive solution to meet the evolving security demands of the digital industrial era.

articleTitle: Enhancing Operational Efficiency through the Integration of CI/CD and DevOps in Software Deployment
publicationTitle: 2024 Sixth International Conference on Computational Intelligence and Communication Technologies (CCICT)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving digital era, the complexity and dynamic nature of software applications have significantly increased, driven by ever-changing consumer and business requirements. This shift poses a challenge to traditional software development and deployment methodologies, which often struggle to keep pace with these rapid changes. This paper explores the transition from conventional methods to agile methodologies, emphasizing their critical role in maintaining application stability and facilitating seamless updates with minimal impact on end-users. Central to this study is the examination of automated deployment models, particularly Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD), and their transformative impact on the software deployment process. The research delves into the intricacies of the DevOps lifecycle, highlighting the importance of various environments such as Development (Dev), Testing (Test), and Production (Prod). These environments are crucial in ensuring that any updated version of an application is rigorously tested and free of bugs before its deployment in a production setting. Through a comprehensive case study conducted in an AWS lab environment, this paper demonstrates the effectiveness of automated deployment models in overcoming the limitations inherent in manual deployment processes. The findings reveal significant improvements in operational efficiency, product quality, and customer satisfaction. The study also discusses the broader implications of these findings, including the necessity for businesses to adopt modern, agile deployment strategies to stay competitive and responsive in the digital landscape. This research contributes to the understanding of how automated deployment strategies, underpinned by CI/CD and DevOps practices, can revolutionize software development processes. It provides valuable insights for organizations looking to enhance their software deployment methodologies, ultimately leading to improved business outcomes and customer experiences in the digital age.
